notes: Items 1-5 met. The round-5 defect is gone. The CdLastPos() pointer now goes straight into `CdControl(2, CdLastPos(), 0)` (SOTN cdread.c:78), so it is no longer laundered through the reused s32 temp_s0. `CdControl(0xE, &sp10, 0)` passes the one-byte Setmode parameter as a u8*, which matches the truthful libcd.h prototype `s32 CdControl(u8, u8 *, u8 *)`. temp_s0 now holds only the mode word and its low byte, which is a single semantic value. Both `volatile s32 *` handles (tsl, md) are FAKE-labelled with measured reasons, and the round-5 ablation showed they are load-bearing. Every cdread-block extern has a row in volatile_extern_allowlist.txt (lines 32 and 49-60). sandbox --disable all = 0 (133/133). build/bb2.exe SHA1 == oracle and the build is newer than every touched source.
